claims.statement: A training game can be followed by snack feeding; this is a whole-game boundary, not each arrow sequence.

Historical guide: category and school preferences yield liked (+1 XP/Power) or loved (+2 XP/Power) outcomes. Treat exact numbers as unqualified expectations.
The official guide distinguishes neutral, liked and loved feedback and associates preferences with Power gain.
Historical separate Pet HUD snack operation restores Happiness; cap derives from trained stats in this source. Do not assume training XP from consumption.
Backpack feeding consumes ordinary items and can yield rewards; this is excluded from snack training.
